description: Claude Code 2.1.258 headless (`claude -p --output-format json`), no MCP server, no plugin, auto-memory disabled via CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 set by claude-harness/harness-c.mcp.json, answers every probe by reading the repository file by file with the built-in Read/Grep/Glob tools, same prompts and same permission mode as the other arms, no ingestion/precompute step by construction.
